description: This file defines the class `AM_ProjectTemplatesTable`, which generates an HTML table for displaying project tasks and resources within a project template in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for rendering the table, retrieving linked user and contact resources, and handling task display logic.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesTable
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering a project task table for project templates, including fetching related resources and generating HTML output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a project template ID and a list of tasks, then calls the draw() method to render the table.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates and outputs an HTML table displaying tasks related to a project template, including resource links and task details.
